programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)
programs.feeNote: Total for two years (subject to revision): tuition 19,23,010 + boarding 2,08,400 + lodging 2,19,500 + learning material 1,24,000 + student activities 62,500 + library 75,400 + alumni 15,000 + refundable security deposit 27,500. Same fee for PGDM, PGDM-HRM and PGDM-Business Analytics. Paid in 3 instalments (6,00,000 at admission; 7,48,905 in Oct 2027; 13,06,405 in May 2028). NRI fee USD 38,668.
programs.intakeNote: NIRF 2026 data submitted by MDI (hosted on mdi.ac.in): sanctioned intake 570 for all 2-year PG programmes combined (2024-25). Graduating 2024-26 PGDM batch had 313 students (placement report).
programs.placementNote: Official MDI Final Placement Report 2024-26 (PGDM, 313 students): entire batch average 29.5 L, median 29.0 L; top-10 percentile average 45.7 L. Institute-wide: 157 recruiters, 189 PPOs, highest CTC 97.50 L (BFSI). Audit not stated.

programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management - Human Resource Management (PGDM-HRM)
programs.feeNote: Same fee schedule as PGDM (subject to revision), incl. boarding, lodging and refundable security deposit 27,500.
programs.intakeNote: Programme-specific seats not published; graduating 2024-26 PGDM-HRM batch had 124 students.
programs.placementNote: Official MDI Final Placement Report 2024-26, PGDM-HRM (124 students): batch average 24.8 L (up from 24.14 L), median 23.0 L.

selectionProcess.weightage: CAT 35%, GD 10%, WAT 5%, BAT 5%, PI 20%, Graduation 5%, Academic diversity 2.5%, Gender diversity 2.5%, Regional diversity 2.5%, Sports 2.5%, Work experience 10%
selectionProcess.detail: WAT-GD-PI between February and April 2027 at Gurugram/Bengaluru/Kolkata/Hyderabad/Ahmedabad/Mumbai (non-Gurugram centres tentative). Final selection intimated April 2027.

selectionWeightage.note: Stage-II final selection weights, proposed for PGP 2027-29.

keyDates.notes: MDI online application closes 28 Nov 2026, 5:00 PM IST; CAT 2026 on 29 Nov 2026. WAT-GD-PI Feb-Apr 2027; final selection April 2027. Application fee Rs 3,000 incl. GST (Rs 3,590 for MDI-G + MDI-M).
